stem: A harvest task now requires a technical repair outside Technician I training. What should happen?
choices: Attempt the repair if the harvest window is time-sensitive and the fault appears simple.
Bypass the fault long enough to finish the current lot and call maintenance afterward.
Mark the repair complete so the work order can close while a qualified person is contacted.
Stop the affected work and escalate the repair need rather than improvising beyond Technician I training or authorization.
rationale: A technical repair outside Technician I training marks an authority boundary. Time pressure does not make improvised repair acceptable. The technician should stop the affected work, preserve the equipment and lot status, and escalate so a qualified person can restore the system safely.
